messages:
ciara: Heads up — onboarding the xformer-large weights from gs://redwood-models/onboard/v3/checkpoint-7. When I run a quick inference with our chat template I see an extra start sentinel injected into the user message output. Anyone seen this pattern before?
ashley: can you paste the weights path + the exact command you used?
ciara: path above. repro command: `python -m rwi.run_infer --model gs://redwood-models/onboard/v3/checkpoint-7 --template chat_v2 --input 'Tell me a joke'`
ciara: sample output (trimmed):
```
<s><|startofchat|> User: Tell me a joke
Assistant: Why did the...
```
ciara: note the `< s>` plus `<|startofchat|>` both present — looks duplicated.
sam: that smells like tokenizer config mismatch. some versions set `add_bos=true` in the tokenizer config while our chat template also inserts the chat sentinel. if both happen you get double markers.
lee: I can run the tokenizer checks. which tokenizer.json is packaged with the weights? checksum?
ciara: there's a `tokenizer.json` at gs://redwood-models/onboard/v3/checkpoint-7/tokenizer.json. sha256: `f2a9b3c4...`
ashley: fyi we've had similar silently failing cases where `bos_token` is set to `"<s>"` and `additional_special_tokens` contains `"<|startofchat|>"`. config validation should catch overlapping sentinel roles. opening a quick PR to add a lint step to the onboarding pipeline. @sam can you take a look? :eyes:
sam: yep I'll review. quick patch idea: validator ensures only one of `add_bos` or chat-template sentinel insertion is active and that `bos_token` != chat_sentinel. also check whitespace-normalization rules because some tokenizers collapse leading spaces differently.
ciara: putting a small reproducer in the repo so CI can fail fast:
```bash
# reproducer
python tools/check_tokenizer_compat.py --model-path gs://redwood-models/onboard/v3/checkpoint-7 --template chat_v2
```
lee: running now, will paste logs.
deploy-bot: build 5142 started for PR #3214 (tokenizer-lint): https://ci.redwood.internal/5142 :gear:
lee: log snippet: `tokenizer: bos_token=<s> chat_sentinel=<|startofchat|> add_bos=true -> duplicated prefix length=2`
lee: also saw that the tokenizer's merge table maps whitespace prefix differently, so messages starting with a space end up dropping the sentinel in one codepath and duplicating in another.
ashley: action items: 1) merge the validator PR (small, low-risk) 2) sam to add a one-off compat-fix that normalizes token insertion order for onboarding (drop add_bos when chat template is used) 3) ciara to add unit test for the checkpoint we just onboarded.
sam: I'll push the compat-fix patch in ~1h and add a guard in the runtime that logs when two sentinels would be emitted.
ciara: great — thanks all. @lee please ping here with the full logs and I'll attach them to the onboarding ticket. I'll hold rollout of checkpoint-7 until PRs land. :thumbsup:
ashley: tagging the code-review checklist: please include a changelog note so dedicated infra knows this model needs config sync after deploy.
ciara: noted. I'll update ticket with the timeline.
